questionSnapshot.question: In The Jungle Book, what is the name of the villainous tiger?

notes: Four in-film jungle animals, only one a tiger. Medium. #2094 concerns which antagonist returns seeking revenge in the 2003 sequel; Kaa is also an original antagonist, so original tiger identity alone does not establish the sequel event.

verification.context: The Jungle Book, Disney animated 1967 film.

options.reason: Shere Khan is identified as the cunning tiger.

sources.locator: Synopsis: Shere Khan the tiger, King Louie the orangutan, Kaa the snake, Bagheera the panther.
